description: This file defines the Localization class used in SuiteCRM. It provides methods for handling character sets, number, currency, and name formatting according to locale settings. It also manages currency data, charset translations, and localized name display formats.

classes.name: Localization
classes.description: A manager class for handling locale-specific settings such as character sets, number and currency formatting, and name display formats.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes default locale name format and loads currencies.

methods.name: getLocaleConfigDefaults
methods.description: Returns an array of default locale configuration based on system and user preferences.

methods.name: getPrecedentPreference
methods.description: Retrieves the most relevant preference for a given setting, considering user, config, and class defaults.

methods.name: loadCurrencies
methods.description: Loads active currency data from the database and cache.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the array of loaded currencies.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of default currency data.

methods.name: translateStringPack
methods.description: Recursively translates an array of strings into a specified charset.

methods.name: translateForEmail
methods.description: Translates a string or array into the outbound email charset.

methods.name: prepBeanForExport
methods.description: Prepares a SugarBean object for export by translating its string fields.

methods.name: translateCharset
methods.description: Translates a string from one charset to another, using mbstring or iconv.

methods.name: addBOM
methods.description: Prefixes a string with a Byte Order Mark based on charset.

methods.name: translateCharsetMIME
methods.description: Encodes a string for MIME headers in a specified charset.

methods.name: normalizeCharset
methods.description: Normalizes charset strings to lowercase alphanumeric forms.

methods.name: getCharsetSelect
methods.description: Provides a list of available charsets for selection, with translatable labels.

methods.name: getExportCharset
methods.description: Returns the preferred charset for exports based on user/system preferences.

methods.name: getOutboundEmailCharset
methods.description: Returns the preferred charset for outbound emails.

methods.name: getDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator based on user/system preferences.

methods.name: getNumberGroupingSeparator
methods.description: Returns the grouping separator for numbers.

methods.name: getPrecision
methods.description: Returns the number of significant digits for currency formatting.

methods.name: getCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol based on preferences.

methods.name: getLocaleFormattedNumber
methods.description: Formats a number according to locale-specific decimal and grouping rules.

methods.name: getNumberJs
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side number formatting.

methods.name: getLocaleFormatMacro
methods.description: Retrieves the locale-specific name format macro string.

methods.name: getLocaleFormattedName
methods.description: Returns a formatted name according to locale preferences (e.g., First Last, Last, First).

methods.name: getNameJs
methods.description: Provides JavaScript for live preview of name formatting.

methods.name: isAllowedNameFormat
methods.description: Checks if a name format string contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: invalidLocaleNameFormatUpgrade
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a file indicating an invalid locale name format during upgrade.

methods.name: createInvalidLocaleNameFormatUpgradeNotice
methods.description: Creates a file to signal an invalid name format during upgrade.

methods.name: removeInvalidLocaleNameFormatUpgradeNotice
methods.description: Removes the signaling file after fixing name format issues.

methods.name: getUsableLocaleNameOptions
methods.description: Filters locale name options to include only valid formats with examples.

methods.name: detectCharset
methods.description: Attempts to detect charset used in a string.
